description: Add ONE reason for update (reasonForUpdate) to the status element of an IN-WORK data module, and nothing else: the content is not touched and no change markup is added. Use it for a change that has no change markup: an editorial change (updateReasonType urt01), or an issue whose issueType is revised or status. For a change that IS shown with change markup, do not use this tool: pass marking.reason to edit_data_module, which adds the reason and the markup together. A reason added here can be referred to by later marked edits through marking.reasonRefId (not a urt01 reason). The text and updateReasonType are the user's; nothing is filled in. Refused: a released issue (inWork "00": call start_revision first), an id already in the document. Returns added, xml (unless includeXml is false), reasonForUpdate {id, updateReasonType}, refusals[], newSchemaErrors[], verification, fixes[]. Writes only when write is true (a path is overwritten in place).

allowInvalid.description: With write: true, write even when verification.schema.state is "invalid". Default false.

csdbDirs.description: CSDB folders used to resolve references, find BREX and number new objects (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file). The FIRST folder is also where write: true writes (it may not exist yet). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); other folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes.

includeXml.description: Include the XML in the response (default: true when write is false, false when write is true).

maxFixes.description: Cap on the remaining fixes listed in the response (default 50).

overwrite.description: With write: true, replace a file of the same name. Default false: an existing file is left alone and reported as write-conflict.

product.description: The product to evaluate applicability for. attributes: ACT productAttribute id → value; conditions: CCT cond id → value. Omit to skip the applicability check.

reason.description: One reason for update (reasonForUpdate in the status element). The text and the type are the user's: never fill them in.

id.description: reasonForUpdate/@id. Omit it: an id that is not in the document is made (rfu-0001 …). An id already in the document is refused.

text.description: The text of the reason (one simplePara).

updateHighlight.description: "1": this reason goes into the Highlights data module.

updateReasonType.description: S1000D updateReasonType, written as given: urt01 editorial change (no change markup may refer to it), urt02 technical change, urt03 markup only, urt04 applicability only, urt05 references only; urt51-urt99 are project values. Required: it is never chosen for you.

write.description: Write the result into the CSDB (the first folder of csdbDirs / S1000D_CSDB_DIR). Default false: the XML is only returned. Nothing is written when the XML is not valid against the XSD unless allowInvalid is true.

xml.description: An existing document as an XML string (alternative to path; max 5 MB). Not for XML you wrote yourself: build new data modules with build_data_module.

name: add_reason_for_update
